# Code of conduct

This project follows the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) (CC BY 4.0), in short form.

## Our pledge

We want participation to be a harassment-free experience for everyone, whatever their age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be kind, patient and respectful. Disagree about ideas, not people.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- Assume good faith, and ask when something is unclear.
- Keep discussion on topic and in public, except for security reports.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, threats, discrimination, or sexualised language and imagery.
- Publishing other people's private information without permission.
- Spam, or repeatedly pushing for work after a maintainer has decided.
- Anything else that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments, issues and pull requests, and may block people who do not follow this code. Report problems to the maintainers privately through a GitHub security advisory or by contacting the repository owner. Reports are handled in confidence.

This applies in all project spaces, and when someone represents the project in public.
